newsitem.title: UK: Shell takes eight April Brents from BP - trade.
newsitem.headline: Shell takes eight April Brents from BP - trade.

text.p: Oil major Shell bought eight cargoes of North Sea Brent Blend crude from British Petroleum on Thursday, traders said.
The cargoes, due to load in the April 11-21 period, were sold at differentials to Dated Brent quotes, the traders said.
Earlier, traders said Shell may have taken as many as 11 cargoes from BP.
Two or three Brents may also have been sold by BP to Wall Street trader Phibro, they added.
Separately, an April 10-12 Brent cargo moved between traders at May Brent less 93 cents, within this week's trading range.
